source.content: public class AssuranceRuntimeBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject>, Database.Stateful { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext context) { return Database.getQueryLocator(new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'assurance batch')}); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext context, List<SObject> scope) {} public void finish(Database.BatchableContext context) {} }
public class AssuranceRuntimeCallable implements System.Callable { public Object call(String action, Map<String,Object> args) { return action == 'echo' ? args.get('value') : action; } }

public class AssuranceRuntimeStub implements System.StubProvider { public Object handleMethodCall(Object stubbedObject, String stubbedMethodName, Type returnType, List<Type> listOfParamTypes, List<String> listOfParamNames, List<Object> listOfArgs) { return null; } }

global class AssuranceRuntimeHttpMock implements HttpCalloutMock { global HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest request) { HttpResponse response = new HttpResponse(); response.setStatusCode(200); return response; } }
